levers.label: Machine-vision fleet
levers.note: Edge inference stays customer-side, so Azure carries the image archive, retraining and low-confidence escalations: modest per plant, material across a fleet. Pays back through inspection labour and escape cost.

levers.label: High-frequency condition monitoring
levers.note: Small for Azure: the edge extracts features and only scheduled raw snapshots travel, so storage and compute are a few thousand dollars per plant (continuous raw streaming multiplies it). Its value is earlier failure detection.

levers.label: Continuous sim-first what-if at scale
levers.note: Discrete-event simulation is cheap; Azure consumption becomes material only with Monte-Carlo rollouts at scale or physics-level fidelity. Its value is earning higher autonomy levels.

levers.label: Enterprise data-platform modernisation
levers.note: The largest single step: Fabric capacity moves from plant level to enterprise scale. Power BI Pro and other Microsoft 365 licences are not Azure consumption.

levers.label: OT security & connectivity hardening
levers.note: A risk and compliance lever: it adds Sentinel, Firewall Premium, a second ExpressRoute path and Defender for Servers, but does not pay for itself on expected-loss value alone. Defender for IoT OT licences are Microsoft 365, not ACR.

expansion.case: Expansion case: the five expansion levers at their Upside adoption on top of this scenario's other assumptions (levers are OFF in Base and Conservative).
